claims.text: For the fixed retained n6 input, fresh and sparse-checkpoint-restored native executions produce the same original-checker-accepted D5 certificate hash and exact count; this qualifies software only and makes no n50 LFD inference.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Deterministic exact outputs; no timing comparison.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Separate six-case hook test rejects invalid cadence and context before deletion; this frozen native control is a fixed positive replay, not a null-population test.

positive.not_applicable_reason: The retained n6 reference certificate SHA-256 7cf2d46d96fe00dfddd1277935c7f0b6577c7ab9cbdc774151c81f56fee82d73, independent checker and exact count 3 are asserted for fresh and restored cases.

decision_rule.text: All three actual worker cases pass; source stops at a published sequence-3 checkpoint, restore selects it, and fresh/restored original-checker-accepted D5 certificates equal the retained hash with exact count 3.
decision_rule.threshold: No missing or failed case; fresh and restored hashes equal retained reference.

placement.checkpoint_detail: Native binary saves every chunk; hook publishes every third seed snapshot and every phase transition/closure round; fake object store only. Source stops at published checkpoint 3; restore must select it.

inadmissible: Inferring a new LFD bound from these fixtures.
Treating a checkpoint stop as a completed certificate.
Restarting fresh when a requested restore cannot be verified.
invalidation_rules: Any input or source hash mismatch prevents launch.
Missing or failed actual cases leave integration unqualified.
Local fake storage does not qualify cloud frontier resources.
Missing published sequence-3 checkpoint, restore from a different context, or certificate hash mismatch invalidates software qualification.

literature.claim: Full degree-bounded closure defines last fall degree; this qualification does not itself certify a new bound.
Candidate bounded publication semantics and remaining native qualification gate.

primary.definition: One if all frozen assertions for this actual case pass.
primary.name: exact recovery control result

question: Does one retained n6 input produce the same independently checked D5 certificate after native stop and restore across two unpublished seed chunks?

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact named-input replay has no arm-dependent clock inference.

blinding.how: Exact inputs and prior campaign are visible; no population or timing inference.

instance_sampling.rule: One fixed retained n6 fixture, reused in every arm; no population inference.

seed_derivation.note: Seed 0 labels fixed input ids 0..2; no random generation.

power.note: Exact named-input verification, no population inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Conservative one-fixture three-arm software-control watchdog; not a runtime prediction.

stopping_rules.rule: One attempt per mode, in fresh/source/restored order; withhold dependent restore after source failure and record it as incomplete. No automatic retry.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Deterministic exact software controls; no performance comparison.

comparisons.threshold: All three modes pass on the one retained fixture; restored certificate and count match fresh and retained reference.
